slides.title: Nine avatars, nine grahas

slides.label: The story
slides.title:
Rama kept his
father’s word
body: He was the king who left his throne to keep it, and he ruled by dharma, the right way.
slides.closing: The way the Sun gives light to all alike

slides.label: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra · ch. 3
slides.title:
The Sun is the king,
the father, the soul
body: In Jyotish the Sun is the king of the grahas.
slides.closing: The light that shines on all alike

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title: Your Sun’s house
body: The house of your Sun shows where you are asked to lead and to keep your word.
slides.note: Sutram’s reading, built on the classical meanings

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Try it today
slides.closing: Keep one promise, to someone else or to yourself
